snippet.title: From Jianghu - A martial arts dream full of infinite imagination.
snippet.description:
From Jianghu is an indie game that combines martial arts, role-playing, and simulation elements. In the game you need to play as the head of a small sects to survive in this treacherous jianghu.
Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058770/_From_Jianghu/
